vb_textbox.text: Try out the colours. They seem to always work in pairs, so once you found the 2 that will result in a higher number of mushrooms (5-6+), stick to those 2. If they start going low, try the combination of the other 2. Stick with that pair until the numbers on those start dropping too. If, regardless of which colours you choose, the numbers are low, just keep sticking to the ones you had better results with last as they will probably result in higher numbers again soon (it's not the 'wrong gnomes,' it's the 'wrong forest' - not enough mushrooms.)
